fact: Guinea's government launched mapping of State agricultural land in Boke, Conakry, Kankan and Kindia on 6 October 2025, feeding a national database connected to the future e-Foncier rural platform, with a dematerialised agricultural land cadastre named as a component of the reform (Agronews Guinee).
Guinea's urbanism ministry secretary general said on 24 November 2025 that the land-title issuance system has been digitised so that duplicate titles are no longer possible.
